cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.population: Family and genetic studies, mostly in European-derived populations
record.design: Review of the genetic basis of vitiligo
record.finding: Heritability from family studies in European-derived people is 0.75 to 0.83, and more than 50 susceptibility regions are known. The abstract does not give the chance that a child of a person with vitiligo will have it.
record.note: Evidence is from European-derived populations; our search found none from Black populations on inheritance.
